description: Zero-credit R-014 bootstrap. It validates the current source-bound fixture and declares the smallest live cockpit surface needed to observe, issue one native action, recover only the advertised activity interruption, return a fresh observation, retain long-activity boundaries, finish, ingest, and clean up. Setup and this bootstrap grant no gameplay or certification credit.

evidence_contract.claim: the current source-bound R-014 prototype footing is selectable and may receive exactly one canonical live cockpit authority; setup and bootstrap artifacts remain zero-credit
evidence_contract.failure_rule: a changed source or fixture, missing required stabilizer, unadvertised native action or recovery, missing fresh observation or long-activity boundary, absent terminal report/ingestion, or failed cleanup leaves the R-014 live route unproved; no setup artifact may be promoted

name: r014.cockpit_live_prototype_bootstrap_mcw

proof_gates.label: R-014 source-bound zero-credit cockpit prototype footing

input: frame-bound semantic wait and advertised activity recovery

authority: activity.ignore only when a current native interruption advertises it
steps.expected_visible_fact: the worker owns one bound live prototype transaction: native action, only advertised recovery, a new avatar-visible observation, explicit finish, immutable ingestion, and accepted cleanup
invariants: preserve the bootstrap scenario, exact source and executable binding, fixture world, player, and current native session
do not use debug state mutation, repair authority, or setup artifacts as gameplay proof
finish on a confirmed transaction or the first unsafe, unclassified, stale, missing-receipt, binding-drift, or no-progress divergence
steps.label: r014_worker_owned_live_prototype
steps.objective: Use the bound cockpit to perform one advertised native action, recover only an advertised activity interruption if it occurs, receive a fresh observation, report the unsupported action once as a reusable gap, retrieve that gap for the declared companion scenario, and explicitly finish.
proof_targets: one native action has a bound receipt and confirmed postcondition
a fresh observation follows the transaction
an unsupported action creates exactly one reusable durable gap and the companion scenario can retrieve it
run.finish creates an immutable report that the registry ingests only after accepted cleanup
